pages.weekly_review.ack_desc: Acknowledge that this finding has been checked and is acceptable. The acknowledgement is stored with the report when it is confirmed.
pages.weekly_review.archived_detail: Generation, editing, confirmation and deletion are disabled for an archived project. Reports and exports stay available.
pages.weekly_review.archived_message: An archived project is read-only. History and export still work; every write is disabled.
pages.weekly_review.banner_problem: The weekly review module reported a problem
pages.weekly_review.checks_clean_message: No findings: errors, warnings and acknowledgements are all clear.
pages.weekly_review.checks_not_run_messa: Saving the body runs the validation; confirming re-validates on the service side.
pages.weekly_review.confirm_blocked: {n} findings still need an acknowledgement before the report can be confirmed.
pages.weekly_review.confirm_blocked_hint: Close this dialog, acknowledge each finding on the Checks tab, then confirm again.
pages.weekly_review.confirm_desc: A confirmed report becomes read-only for the module; reopen it as a draft to edit again.
pages.weekly_review.confirm_ready: Every finding has been acknowledged. Confirming freezes the body and records the confirmed hash.
pages.weekly_review.conflict_message: Nothing was overwritten. Reload the report to see the stored body, then reapply your edit.
pages.weekly_review.delete_message: “{title}” moves to the Recycle Bin. It can be restored from report history.
pages.weekly_review.deleted_message: Restore it from the report history to edit it again.
pages.weekly_review.deleted_title: This report is in the Recycle Bin
pages.weekly_review.description: The weekly reports of {project}: generate, edit, validate, confirm and export.
pages.weekly_review.diff_desc: The new draft has already replaced the body. Review the change; undo restores the previous text.
pages.weekly_review.digest_empty_reason: No activity was recorded in this period. The report body can still be written by hand or with AI.
pages.weekly_review.digest_housekeeping_: Creating, importing, deleting and exporting are operations, not research progress: they stay out of the body and are not counted as work.
Filing records ({n}, not counted as progress)
pages.weekly_review.digest_truncated: The digest hit the event cap; the oldest events may be missing.
pages.weekly_review.disabled_reason: The composition root did not assemble the SPEC-09 services for this workspace, so no report can be read. Restart the application.
pages.weekly_review.disabled_title: The weekly review module is not available
pages.weekly_review.empty_reason: Generate this week's report to summarize the project's activity, or pick another period.
pages.weekly_review.err_ai_output_invali: The AI draft did not follow the seven-section template. The deterministic skeleton was stored instead; edit it and retry.
pages.weekly_review.err_ai_unavailable: AI is not available, so the deterministic seven-section skeleton was stored. Edit it or retry once a provider is configured.
pages.weekly_review.err_confirmation_req: This action needs an in-app user decision.
pages.weekly_review.err_confirmed_read_o: This report is confirmed. Reopen it as a draft before editing or regenerating.
pages.weekly_review.err_content_too_larg: The body exceeds the 512 KiB limit.
pages.weekly_review.err_export_dir_missi: The export directory does not exist.
pages.weekly_review.err_export_exists: A file with this name already exists. Turn on overwrite to replace it.
pages.weekly_review.err_internal: The weekly review module failed internally.
pages.weekly_review.err_invalid_actor: The actor is not allowed to write reports.
pages.weekly_review.err_invalid_export_p: The export directory must be inside the workspace.
pages.weekly_review.err_invalid_period: The period is not valid: pick a start and an end day, the end not before the start.
pages.weekly_review.err_period_occupied: A report already exists for this period.
pages.weekly_review.err_project_archived: The project is archived; reports are read-only.
pages.weekly_review.err_report_not_empty: The report already has content. Confirm the overwrite first.
pages.weekly_review.err_unresolved_viola: Some findings are still unresolved; acknowledge them first.
pages.weekly_review.err_unsupported_form: Only Markdown and HTML export are supported.
pages.weekly_review.export_desc: Exports a standalone Markdown or HTML document named after the period; the HTML file is self-contained and ready to share or print.
pages.weekly_review.export_draft_message: This report is still a draft. Its front matter records status: draft.
pages.weekly_review.gen_desc: Pick the week and generate. The report is created or overwritten in place; nothing else on this page waits for it.
pages.weekly_review.gen_note_title: Generation fell back to the skeleton
pages.weekly_review.insert_ref_desc: References come from this period's activity digest; the chosen one is appended to the body as a bullet.
pages.weekly_review.insert_ref_empty: The digest has no entity to reference in this period.
pages.weekly_review.needs_project_desc: Weekly reports belong to a project.
pages.weekly_review.needs_project_reason: Open a project to see its report history.
pages.weekly_review.preview_confirmed: This period's report is confirmed. Reopen it as a draft before regenerating.
pages.weekly_review.preview_exists: The period already has a report: {title}. Generation replaces its body.
pages.weekly_review.preview_new: No report exists for this period yet; generation creates one.
pages.weekly_review.preview_no_ai: AI is not configured: generation writes the deterministic seven-section skeleton.
pages.weekly_review.preview_no_instructi: Instructions are not supported by the current generation API; the fixed template is used.
pages.weekly_review.preview_overwrite_de: The existing draft has content. Without this the service refuses to replace it.
pages.weekly_review.regen_desc: The service replaces the body in place. The page keeps the previous text so the Diff viewer can show the change and undo it.
pages.weekly_review.regen_note: Existing content is sent back to the model only through the deterministic digest; the current body is replaced after a successful generation.
pages.weekly_review.revert_desc: The report returns to draft so the body and its validation can be edited again.
pages.weekly_review.skill_card_hint: A skill decides how the report is written: what to emphasise, how to judge whether an idea has evidence, what counts as progress. The validation contract (seven sections, references, number provenance) stays in code and cannot be changed by a skill.
pages.weekly_review.skill_edit_desc: This text is sent with every section call and steers how the model writes it.
pages.weekly_review.skill_prompt_hint: One point per line: what to emphasise, what to avoid. Instructions that conflict with the validation contract are ignored.
pages.weekly_review.title: Weekly Review
pages.weekly_review.toast_deleted: Report moved to the Recycle Bin
pages.weekly_review.toast_open_fail: The file could not be opened
pages.weekly_review.toast_reveal_fail: The folder could not be opened
pages.weekly_review.toast_skeleton_note: AI is not configured; the deterministic seven-section skeleton was written.
